scope: Original exact GF(2) flip/plus/shared-factor-reduction implementation, inspired by arXiv:2609.17533v2; not an execution of the paper authors GPU binary. Each trial is an independent ensemble; walks in pool policy share elite schemes. All policies paired by initial random seed and nominal wall budget. Target times are host-observed chunk upper bounds; unsuccessful trials remain censored. Complete verified wall includes final D2H and exact CPU verification of every walk, excludes initial allocation and warm-up. Lower rank alone is not a demonstrated hardware GEMM speedup. Diverse8 canonicalizes term order, retains up to eight distinct best schemes and reseeds the worst quarter cyclically from them; kernel transitions and initial budgets stay unchanged.
